Notes.FootstepIndex: Footstep sound index, cycles 0-4. NOT ammo -- looks like a magazine at a glance (small cyclic range, changes per step). Dead end, see PROTOCOL.md 16.
Notes.FootstepDistance: Distance accumulator driving FootstepIndex. Rises monotonically. Not ammo.
Notes.DistanceWalked: Distance-walked accumulator feeding WeaponBob. Presentation only.
Notes.SwayLean: Sway/lean ramp, 0 -> 45 then decays. Presentation only.
Notes.AmmoPerSlot: int[] indexed by weapon slot. PRIME ammo candidate -- ammo is not a scalar on any watched object (166 checked). Unconfirmed.
Notes.ActiveWeaponId: Active weapon id. Writing an ammo count here causes NO WEAPON -- do not treat as a counter.
Notes.StatsArray: int[] stats. DO NOT WRITE -- corrupts player state.
Notes.Health: Player health. Set to 1000 for infinite health.
Notes.MaxHealth: Player max health. Set to 1000 for infinite health.
Notes.Armor: Player armor. Set to 1000 for infinite health.
Notes.IsDead: Bool. Clear to false for infinite health (prevents death state persisting).
Notes.IsDown: Bool. Clear to false for infinite health (prevents downed state persisting).
Notes.SpawnProtected: Bool. True = player has spawn protection. Used to skip targets in aimbot.
Notes.Spread: Current weapon spread / recoil accumulator. Set to -1000f before fire, +1000f after for rapid fire.
Notes.RootObject: GameObject 'New Game Object' — player root transform.
Notes.Head: GameObject 'head' — head hitbox, used for aimbot target.
Notes.Rigidbody: Player rigidbody, used for bunnyhop grounded check (velocity.y).
Notes.ActiveWeapon: Property returning CGJPBNDDPIN (current weapon instance). Null if no weapon.
Notes.Team: Player team id. Used for teammate detection in aimbot/ESP.

Notes.FireInput: FLOAT (0x44). Cached left-mouse state: 1=firing, 0=not. Game reads Input.GetMouseButton(0) at start of Update and stores here. Setting in prefix gets overwritten by Update. Setting in postfix persists to next frame.
Notes.Yaw: FLOAT (0x3C). Aim yaw angle (Mouse X). Used for silent aim redirect.
Notes.Pitch: FLOAT (0x40). Aim pitch angle (Mouse Y). Used for silent aim redirect.
Notes.Camera: Camera (0x88). Main camera. Used for raycast origin and WorldToScreenPoint.
Notes.ReloadEndTime: Reload completion stamp, normally start + 2.0. A perfect reload SUBTRACTS from this; that is the whole mechanism. Must be written from the Update PREFIX -- a postfix write lands after the game has read it and only collapses the UI bar.
Notes.IsReloading: True for the duration of a reload.
Notes.HitList: List<DMHBMAAFCFJ> (0x1F0). Populated by PLH.CDEGJOBLOFO's raycast. Sent to server via Client.AHLDAPJEJNC.
Notes.HitSequence: int (0x1EC). Hit sequence counter, passed to Client.AHLDAPJEJNC.
Notes.MaxFireRate: float (0x1A8). Same offset as ReloadStartTime — fire rate cap.
Notes.CurrentFireRate: float (0x1AC). Same offset as ReloadEndTime — current fire rate timer.

Notes.SendHitReport: internal void AHLDAPJEJNC(Vector3 origin, uint seq, List<Hit> hits) - send hit report
Notes.ProcessPacket: internal void FPIDGCHIEMJ(byte[] receiveBuffer, int receiveLength) - process received packet
Notes.SendWeaponData: void MGPBPDIGDBO(NAHLLMJMOED) - send weapon data to server
Notes.SendLoadoutList: void MPOCJJJJBAN(List<FPNENMKEFBB>) - send loadout entries to server

Notes.Players: KBBBHJDINCB[] (0xC). All players in the match. Used by aimbot to find targets.
Notes.Fire: CDEGJOBLOFO(KBBBHJDINCB player, float fireRate, bool a, bool b). Fires visual shot (sound/muzzle flash). Does NOT send network hit packet — that's done by Client.AHLDAPJEJNC after Controll.Update processes the hit list.
Notes.FireAlt: MFHJFPPOHLC(KBBBHJDINCB, float, bool, bool). Same signature as Fire — alternate fire mode.
Notes.LoadWeaponSkin: PLH.JLAALPNBABH. Loads the weapon model/skin -- PlayerPrefs lookup, TEX.CALGHDNPMLO, Material.SetTexture, VWGen. Previously mis-aliased as Reload; it is NOT the reload entry point and does not touch ammo. See PROTOCOL.md 19.
Notes.GetWeaponData: NAHLLMJMOED FPIJPCOKIEC(KBBBHJDINCB player, string weaponName) - get weapon data by name
Notes.GetLoadoutEntry: FPNENMKEFBB BEDNBOCOJHO(KBBBHJDINCB player, string weaponName) - get loadout entry by name

Notes.Ammo: int (0x5C). Actually the weapon ID, NOT ammo count. Writing here causes NO WEAPON state.

Notes.Point: Vector3 (0x10). Hit point in world space.
